mechanism: Pair source N and G outlines with the corresponding partial-transformation letters in A. Intended error: read a visually matched letter sequence while neglecting the handedness of each glyph under the composed flip.
primary_mathematical_proof: Turning glass onto its back about the right edge reverses x; a subsequent half-turn reverses x and y. Their composition is (x,y)->(x,-y) up to translation: horizontal order KANGAROO stays, while every glyph is reflected vertically. In the frozen source vectors option E is the full vertical reflection. Option A leaves some letters, including the N diagonal, in the wrong handed orientation. Color-only outlines do not move glyph boundaries, alter the black letter fill or change the glass outline. E stays uniquely correct.

marker_roles.role: N is a handed diagonal-bearing glyph: input N and wrong A N create the selective unchanged-diagonal association.
G provides a second ordered asymmetric-letter correspondence and keeps source/output reading positions aligned. No entire glass or choice is highlighted.
